description: Close one of your tickets. `rating` (1-5) and `comment` are OPTIONAL — you can close without rating. Use the ticket code from create_ticket / list_tickets. Requires: token.

comment.description: Optional. Comment for the rating, up to 2000 characters. Default: none.

rating.description: Optional. Support rating, integer 1–5 (5 = excellent). Default: no rating.

ticket_code.description: Required. Ticket code from create_ticket / list_tickets, e.g. "K7Q2M9X".

name: close_ticket
title: Close a support ticket
